Chemical tanker crashes onto autorickshaw, two killed

A chemical tanker crashed onto a moving autorickshaw in Thane, killing two people. The incident occurred on a busy road, and authorities are investigating the cause of the accident. The crash has raised concerns about road safety and the handling of hazardous materials.
